test: Cell characterisation and 2C charge life (25, 0, -10 C)
standard_or_procedure: IEC 62660-1/-2 plus Molicel written charge-life data
acceptance: Capacity and resistance match model inputs; >=80% SOH at the test life with 30% DC fast charge; no plating at -10 C with derate

test: Thermal propagation, lane module (single cell then group of 11, with and without coolant)
standard_or_procedure: Internal target modelled on GB 38031-2020 8.2.7; SAE J2464 practice
acceptance: No external fire or explosion for >=5 min after warning; neighbour cells stay below 170 C; gas leaves by the belly vent

test: Burst vent opening pressure and flow
acceptance: Opens at 15-20 kPa; >=600 mm2 free area each

test: Wire-bond fuse pulse and fusing
standard_or_procedure: Pulse bench per cell datasheet currents
acceptance: Opens under shorted-cell current; neighbour bonds survive; no cell damage

test: Module vibration and shock with resistance monitoring
standard_or_procedure: UN R136 Annex 8A profile (confirm with lab); ISO 16750-3
acceptance: No open bond or cell movement; interconnect resistance change <10%

test: Cast swingarm static, fatigue and X-ray
acceptance: No crack (dye penetrant) after 1.5 lives; casting porosity within class

test: Pivot bearing and stub rig (design load 1.2x, plus 21 kN slider)
acceptance: No yield; L10 >= 160,000 km at spectrum; play within spec after test

test: Steel pivot yoke (rev E, cross-member Z545) static and fatigue proof under belt-loop load; EMRAX housing is not the load path
standard_or_procedure: Static rig at 1.2 x 11.3 kN belt pull plus fatigue to 1.5 lives
acceptance: No yield or crack; deflection below the value used in FEA; weld class confirmed

test: Belt, pulley and hub durability
standard_or_procedure: Gates design manual; launch and regen reversals
acceptance: 1.5 lives, no tooth shear; tension loss <15%; no pulley fretting; tracking within flange limits

test: Motor and inverter dyno (R85-style 30-min power) at 300-330 V and cold
acceptance: Peak >=90 kW at 330 V bus; continuous >=55 kW; no derate surprises vs model

test: Brake dyno: fade and wear
acceptance: 300 mm discs pass fade at 125 mph energy, or move to 320 mm

test: HV electrical safety bench
standard_or_procedure: ISO 6469-3; UN R136 Part I practice; IEC 60529 IPXXB/D
acceptance: Isolation >=500 ohm/V (210 kohm); bond <0.1 ohm; bus <60 V within 3 s of opening; HVIL opens contactors

test: Short-circuit breaking: fuse, contactors, pyro
standard_or_procedure: Bench at pack voltage, 3.4-6.2 kA prospective
acceptance: Fuse and pyro clear without arc or damage; contactors open below 350 A only; fuse I2t within busbar withstand

test: BMS, throttle and VCU hazard analysis, FMEDA and HIL fault injection
standard_or_procedure: ISO 26262 (Part 12 motorcycles) approach; ISO 13849 for non-electronic channels
acceptance: All safety goals met; single faults reach safe state within the fault-tolerant time; ASIL table closed

test: Pack vibration and thermal shock
acceptance: No leak, rupture, fire; isolation >=100 ohm/V

test: UN 38.3 pack-level (T1-T5, T7) plus cell summary
standard_or_procedure: UN Manual of Tests and Criteria 38.3
acceptance: No leakage, venting, rupture or fire; no mass loss; OCV drop <10%

test: UL 2580 pack abuse (voluntary)
acceptance: Report passes; no fire or explosion outside pack

test: Pack crush and rock strike
standard_or_procedure: Internal target: 75 mm half-cylinder to 100 kN (SAE J2464 practice); 50 mm impactor at 3 g bottom-out
acceptance: No fire or explosion; no leakage after 1 h; dent <=12 mm

test: Pack case crash retention (20 g)
standard_or_procedure: Sled pulse test with dummy cells
acceptance: Seams intact; no cell exposure

test: Pack IP67, immersion and hot-into-cold wading
standard_or_procedure: IEC 60529 IP67; hot pack 40 C into 10 C water
acceptance: No ingress; isolation held; no fire in salt immersion

test: Inlet and cable thermal soak at 137 A
acceptance: Rise <=50 K at 40 C ambient for 30 min; no hot spots

test: Charging interoperability and conformance
standard_or_procedure: DIN SPEC 70121 / ISO 15118-2; SAE J3400; J1772 pilot states
acceptance: Complete sessions at >=80% of stations; AC/DC interlock never allows both closed

test: Cooling loop bench and radiator ram-air check
standard_or_procedure: Flow bench; wind tunnel ram factor
acceptance: 74 kPa at 22 L/min; ram factor >=0.25; pump endurance 2,000 h

test: Hose, manifold and ribbon burst and leak
acceptance: No leak at 3x; no pinholes after vibration

test: Frame static proof and stiffness
standard_or_procedure: Hydraulic rig; load cases C1-C6, D1-D3
acceptance: No yield; lateral >=1.5 kN/mm target or documented waiver; torsion >=3 kNm/deg

test: Frame and arm multi-axial fatigue to 1.5 lives
acceptance: No crack after 1.5 x 160,000 km equivalent; bolt preload loss <10%

test: Modal survey and wobble/weave check
acceptance: Frame modes >=2 Hz from wobble/weave and motor orders

test: 125 mph and 130 mph sustained at 25 C and 38 C
acceptance: 25 C: 125 mph held, cell <55 C; 38 C: derates to about 105 mph, cell <60 C, EMRAX inlet within limit

test: DC fast charge 10-80% at -10, 25, 35, 45 C
acceptance: <=25 min at 25 and 35 C; cold with preheat <=25 min; cell <55 C

test: Coastdown and constant-speed range at 70 and 77 mph
acceptance: Range >=145 mi at 70 mph, 90 kg rider; measured CdA

test: Wind tunnel CdA with rider
Acceleration and top speed
acceptance: 0-60 mph <=4.0 s; 125 mph sustained; 130 mph governor

test: Weigh the bike wet, ready to ride
Handling and high-speed stability, gusts at 77 mph
acceptance: Weave and wobble damping positive in all modes; rider rating >=4/5

test: Vehicle-level fault injection (throttle, VCU, ABS, 12 V loss)
acceptance: Safe state in every case; limp-home >=25 min

test: Brake compliance pre-test, including high-speed stop
standard_or_procedure: FMVSS 122 S6; 125 mph stop for design margin
acceptance: Dry stop limits met (front only 37.3 m, rear only 53.9 m from 60 km/h); fade ratio met; regen off for friction tests

test: ABS and regen blending on low-mu surfaces
acceptance: No wheel lock above 15 km/h; regen never reduces total deceleration below demand

test: Tip-over and low-side slide
standard_or_procedure: 10 falls each side; 30 and 50 km/h slide
acceptance: Pack never touches ground; isolation >=100 ohm/V; vent gas path clear

test: Lighting photometry and installation; reflectors; stop-lamp logic
acceptance: All lamps meet photometry and spacing; stop lamp on regen

test: Mirrors, controls and displays, tyres and rims, glazing, brake fluid audit
acceptance: All items meet the standard or a supplier certificate is on file

test: Vehicle EMC and radio
acceptance: Emissions and immunity under limits; keyless and telematics grants

test: Climate, altitude and wading trips
acceptance: No faults; isolation held after wading

test: Durability fleet: road and gravel

acceptance: No structural or HV fault; wear within limits; pyro false trips logged

acceptance: Results match prototype within tolerance

acceptance: Complete file; label and VIN pad on the frame

acceptance: n/a
